winner_missing.violation_when: winner is absent from the evaluated result boundary

provenance_failure.violation_when: present winner lacks required owner provenance

outranked_by_relevance.applicable_when: winner is present and a lower-authority same-subject competitor is present
outranked_by_relevance.violation_when: competitor ranks above the legitimate canonical winner

same_subject_identity: source ID, runtime ID, and path-form source ID are normalized through one concept mapping
authority_order: only eligible same-subject competitors are included; unrelated raw candidates do not create violations
